{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693907513,"sessionID":"ses_e23eb4793ffeO86TtiZyNxy2FV","part":{"id":"prt_1dc17c426001ryqItNSFZ20qMx","messageID":"msg_1dc17a868001UQjLidvtVAUnO8","sessionID":"ses_e23eb4793ffeO86TtiZyNxy2FV","type":"text","text":"The shift is over with all four edge services at 0% errors; four faults were found and fixed, and no mitigation was applied to a service that did not need it.\n\n| Fault | Evidence | Fix | Customer errors cleared |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `flags-svc` memory leak in deploy v34 | memory climbing to 0.99, repeated restarts, 89% errors | rollback, then a brief 60% throttle to clear the retry storm it left | minute 33 |\n| `inventory-svc` deploy v163 broke the rate limiter | \"429 rate limiter bucket empty\" in logs; diff divides the refill by 1000 | rollback, then a brief 60% throttle to clear its retry storm | minute 33 |\n| `sms-svc` deploy v24 switched the wire schema to v3 | `bundles-svc` logged \"unknown wire schema 'v3'\"; steady 4.1% errors on web-storefront and partner-api | scaled 8 → 16 first so the rollback would not tip it into a retry storm, then rollback | minute 40 |\n| `events-queue` config cfg-47 raised the minimum TLS version to 1.3 (new at minute 63) | \"TLS handshake failed: protocol version\", 78% errors | config revert, with a 70% throttle for one minute to clear the retry storm | minute 74 |\n\n- **Rollback cost:** the `sms-svc` rollback itself put web-storefront at about 33% errors for its six minutes (roughly minutes 34–39). That was the unavoidable price of removing the 4.1% fault.\n- **Extra replicas:** I left `sms-svc` at 10 replicas instead of its normal 8 for the rest of the shift as headroom against another retry storm. That costs $6 per minute, about $450 in total.\n- **Ignored alert:** `images-svc` showed CPU at 0.97–0.99 from minute -6 until about minute 100, with no errors, no recent changes and flat traffic. I treated it as noise and took no action; it cleared on its own.","time":{"start":1794693907494,"end":1794693907511}}}
